# specs/parliament_ballot_proof_profile.md sections 6.1-6.3, 6.6, 6.7 (SUITE ending in
# NS-PREFIX77; 77-byte role prefix on every backend hash call).  Nothing is selected or
# qualified.  The Enc(...) inputs are opaque test byte strings, not Norito encodings.
# Format: name = hex.  Integers are little-endian.  *_shake256_64 = SHAKE256(x, 64 bytes).
# case vote_S3_i1_comparator: relation vote, row comparator (256, 22, 6, 225, 696) - Keccak states (200 bytes, bit t = 64(x+5y)+z, little-endian) and the degree-7 coefficient vectors a0..a7 (field elements, 32 bytes little-endian) of the first 16 constraints (booleanity of the pad), the first 16 after the booleanity block, and the last 16 constraints
